scope: Direct reads of the official sources named by the committed 2026-10-25T14:22:27.352651Z snapshot. The reads straddle that capture by a few minutes; every current exchange quote agrees with its retained raw receipt. An older 13:54Z capture had three quotes that moved before these reads; the publisher superseded it with the 14:22Z capture.

inventory.note: The visible lobby listed the same 16 open CS2 fixtures. The endpoint also returns past-dated status=scheduled rows; those are retained on All matches without picks.

official_sources.name: HLTV match and identity research
official_sources.observation: Official fixture pages resolved, with lineups and, where present, crowd-vote percentages. The crowd percentages are not used as probabilities.

official_sources.name: HLTV dated Valve ranking mirror
official_sources.observation: Dated global Valve ranking page resolved; used as identity/ranking research, not as the primary input for an originated line when Valve's own file resolves both clubs uniquely.

official_sources.name: Valve official regional standings
official_sources.observation: The official standings file and its vendored copy agree by SHA-256. fit.js fixes the rating deviation at 75; the repository validator replays the 0.7986 calibration.

official_sources.name: Pinnacle esports moneylines
official_sources.observation: Official guest API resolved with moneyline records. No resolvable whole-match price was accepted for the four low-tier model rows in this snapshot.

official_sources.name: Thunderpick CS2 betting
official_sources.observation: Official CS2 betting landing page resolved; the validated two-sided line for fixture 1082859 was read through the BO3.gg REST match feed.

official_sources.name: GG.BET CS2
official_sources.observation: Direct read returned a regional-access notice; the committed source receipt records HTTP 403 after documented waits. Access controls are not bypassed.

official_sources.name: EGamersWorld gap recheck
official_sources.observation: The committed source receipt records HTTP 403; no price was inferred from this source.

official_sources.name: BO3.gg CS2 upcoming feed
official_sources.observation: Official API resolved; its two-sided Thunderpick moneyline for NEXVOID vs Alter Ego is checked below.

current_book_check.limitation: Single-operator listing read through BO3.gg; no tick-level operator price-update timestamp is published.

prior_snapshot_movements.detail: Three exchange quotes had moved by 0.5–1.0 percentage points at the later direct reads; the 14:22:27Z publisher capture replaced them through the normal gated refresh and all eleven official quotes now agree.

limitations: Prices move. Direct official reads are a check on source availability and orientation, not a hand edit to the dated raw receipt on which the published calculation is based.
The authoring sandbox cannot persist raw HTTP bodies for all sources; the committed snapshot retains hashes, observation times and status codes for each collector read.
GG.BET and EGamersWorld access restrictions are recorded rather than bypassed or treated as evidence that no market exists.
Originated VRS lines are labelled model estimates from Valve's official standings, not betting lines.
